name: Result of the search for neutrinoless double-β decay in 100Mo with the NEMO-3 experiment

summary.plain: With all its data, 6.9 kg of molybdenum-100 over about five live years, NEMO-3 saw no neutrinoless double beta decay. The half-life must exceed 1.1 x 10^24 years, which limits the effective Majorana neutrino mass to below 0.33 to 0.62 eV depending on the nuclear model.
summary.technical: Full data set, live time 4.96 yr, exposure 34.3 kg y of 100Mo; background in [2.8-3.2] MeV 0.44 +- 0.13 counts/yr/kg, no events in [3.2-10] MeV; T1/2 > 1.1e24 yr (90 % C.L., light Majorana neutrino exchange); <m_nu> < 0.33-0.62 eV.

title: Result of the search for neutrinoless double-β decay in 100Mo with the NEMO-3 experiment
why_it_matters: The final result of the experiment that led to the SuperNEMO tracker-calorimeter design.
